objectives: Use wastewater + syndromic + mobility + ML surveillance for outbreak detection.
Map pandemic-preparedness architecture (IHR, pandemic accord, PEPFAR, Gavi, CEPI).
Frame planetary health (Whitmee + Frank) + the SDG 3 + Triple Billion agenda.

slides.title: Digital, wastewater, + AI public-health surveillance
slides.body:
The 2010s + COVID-19 (2020+) brought a paradigm shift in public-health surveillance from reactive case reporting to **near-real-time, multi-stream digital + ML-powered systems**.

**Wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE)** — quantify pathogen RNA + DNA + chemical markers in sewage; aggregate population-level signal upstream of clinical reporting.
- **Polio surveillance** has used environmental sewage sampling for decades (GPEI; Israel + India + Pakistan + Afghanistan environmental surveillance networks).
- **COVID-19 wastewater SARS-CoV-2 RNA** quantified by RT-qPCR + ddPCR; concentrations lead clinical case curves by 4-7 days (Wu + Alm 2020; Peccia 2020). **Biobot Analytics** + CDC's National Wastewater Surveillance System (NWSS 2020+) + Europe's EMCDDA wastewater drug surveillance.
- **Other pathogens** — influenza A/B, RSV, mpox, polio cVDPV (UK 2022 detection from London sewage), antimicrobial-resistance markers (Hendriksen 2019 Global Sewage Surveillance Consortium), Mpox + arboviruses.
- **Strengths**: passive, anonymous, captures asymptomatic shedders, cheap, real-time, scales geographically.
- **Limits**: signal-population denominator uncertainty, viral shedding kinetics, sewer-network gaps in LMICs, ethical questions on community-level surveillance.

**Syndromic surveillance** — ED chief-complaint, OTC purchases, school absenteeism, EHR queries.
- **CDC BioSense + ESSENCE + RODS** systems.
- **Real-time ED chief-complaint analysis** for influenza-like illness, GI, respiratory.
- **Google Flu Trends (2008-2015)** — used search queries to nowcast influenza; overestimated 2012-13 + retired 2015 (Lazer 2014 Science 'Parable of Google Flu'). Modern methods (HealthMap; Brownstein) blend digital with traditional sources.

**Mobility + contact data** — anonymized smartphone-derived movement + contact patterns.
- **Apple Mobility Trends Reports** + **Google Community Mobility Reports** (2020-2022) released during COVID-19 with categorized day-on-day movement changes (residential, workplace, transit, retail).
- **Cuebiq + Facebook Data for Good + Meta Movement Range** — granular population mobility for modeling (Kraemer + Lipsitch + Buckee).
- **Bluetooth-based contact tracing** — Singapore TraceTogether, UK NHS COVID-19 app, EU DP-3T. Mixed adoption + impact; demonstrated viability of decentralized privacy-preserving designs.

**ML + AI for outbreak detection + forecasting**:
- **BlueDot, HealthMap, Metabiota** — text-mining of news + ProMED + social-media + airline + animal-health data; early COVID-19 alerts to clients before WHO declaration.
- **CDC Center for Forecasting and Outbreak Analytics (CFA)** founded 2022 under Caitlin Rivers + Dylan George.
- **COVID-19 Forecast Hub** ensembled dozens of academic + government models (Reich + Ray).
- **Genomic surveillance** — Nextstrain (Bedford + Hodcroft + Neher), GISAID, COG-UK, sequencing variants at scale; foundation for Omicron + Delta detection + tracking.
- **Foundation models** for biology + pathogen surveillance emerging (Evo, Caduceus, NucleoBench).

**Pandemic preparedness through digital tools** — **Ashish Jha** (Brown SPH dean; Biden White House COVID-19 Response Coordinator 2022-23) wrote on integrating wastewater + clinical + genomic surveillance into a routine 'always-on' system, not stood up only during a crisis. **Predict + DEEP VZN** — virus-discovery programs (predict animal-virus spillover; faced controversy over biosecurity).

slides.title: Pandemic preparedness architecture
slides.body:
After SARS 2003, H5N1, H1N1 2009, MERS 2012, Ebola 2014, Zika 2016, COVID-19 2019+, global health-security architecture has matured but remains fragmented + under-funded.

**International Health Regulations (IHR 2005)** — adopted by 196 WHO Member States after SARS. Binding international law. Requirements:
- **National IHR focal point** for 24/7 communication with WHO.
- **Core capacities** — surveillance, response, laboratory, points of entry, risk communication, zoonosis, food safety, chemical, radiation.
- **Notification** of events that may constitute a PHEIC (Public Health Emergency of International Concern) within 24 hours (Annex 2 decision instrument).
- **PHEIC** — invoked 8 times: H1N1 2009; polio 2014; Ebola 2014; Zika 2016; Ebola 2019; COVID-19 2020; mpox 2022; mpox 2024.
- **Critique** — capacity gaps + delayed reporting (China + COVID-19), no real enforcement, slow PHEIC declarations.

**Pandemic Accord + IHR amendments 2024** — WHO Member States agreed at 77th WHA (May 2024) on IHR amendments (definitions, equity, financing) + continued negotiation of the Pandemic Accord (legally binding pandemic instrument). Disputes: tech transfer, pathogen-sharing benefit-sharing, surveillance obligations, equity in countermeasure access. Process driven by INB (Intergovernmental Negotiating Body); CA+ draft. Slated for adoption by WHA 78 in May 2025 (status pending).

**WHO Hub for Pandemic + Epidemic Intelligence** (Berlin 2021) — combines AI + epidemiology + behavioral science for early warning. **EIOS** (Epidemic Intelligence from Open Sources) platform integrates news + reports + lab + social-media signals.

**Joint External Evaluation (JEE)** — voluntary peer review of national IHR core capacities; ~120 countries assessed by 2023; scores show wide variation. WHO Global Health Security Agenda (GHSA 2014+) + UHPR.

**Major financing + R&D mechanisms**:
- **PEPFAR (President's Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief)** — launched 2003 (Bush); largest single-country HIV / AIDS response globally; $110B+ disbursed; ~25M lives saved; ~$5B/yr; in 50+ countries. Architecture for emergency-scale disease-specific response.
- **Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis, Malaria** — founded 2002; multistakeholder; ~$56B disbursed; ~44 million lives saved (2002-2022).
- **Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance** (2000) — co-financing childhood + adolescent vaccines for poorest countries; pneumococcal + rotavirus + HPV; financed COVAX during COVID-19.
- **CEPI (Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations)** — founded 2017 after Ebola West Africa; finances vaccine R&D for priority pathogens (Lassa, Nipah, MERS, Rift Valley, Chikungunya, disease X). Launched **100 Days Mission** (2021 UK G7 presidency; Saville-Smith) — develop + license + manufacture vaccines for a novel pathogen within 100 days of identification. Reference benchmark for next pandemic.
- **The Pandemic Fund** (World Bank-hosted; 2022) — pooled financing for IHR core capacity strengthening.
- **ACT-Accelerator + COVAX (2020-2023)** — coordinated access to tests, treatments, vaccines, PPE during COVID-19; partial success at speed but failed at equity (HIC vaccinated months before LMIC).

**Manufacturing + countermeasure ecosystem** — mRNA technology transfer hub (WHO South Africa Afrigen 2021); regional vaccine manufacturing initiatives (PAVM Partnership for African Vaccine Manufacturing); BARDA (US Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority).

**One Health** — joint surveillance across human + animal + environmental health (zoonotic spillover surveillance via FAO + WOAH + WHO + UNEP Quadripartite). Predict + DEEP VZN + Global Virome Project. Estimated 70%+ of emerging infections originate in animals (Jones 2008 Nature).

slides.title: Planetary health + the SDG + Triple Billion agenda
slides.body:
**Global Burden of Disease (GBD)** — institutionalized at IHME (Murray + Hay) since 2007; tracks 369 diseases + injuries + 87 risk factors across 204 countries + territories + over 30 years. GBD 2024 (Lancet 2024; Murray et al.) — life-expectancy gains stalled or reversed in many HICs due to COVID-19 + drug-related deaths + cardiometabolic stagnation; LMICs show continued NCD transition; ~2.5 billion DALYs annually globally. Foundation for resource allocation + policy.

**UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs 2015-2030)** — 17 goals + 169 targets; SDG 3: 'Ensure healthy lives + promote well-being for all at all ages.' Sub-targets:
- **3.1** Maternal mortality <70/100k.
- **3.2** Neonatal mortality <12 + under-5 mortality <25/1k.
- **3.3** End AIDS, TB, malaria, NTDs; combat HBV + waterborne disease.
- **3.4** Reduce premature NCD mortality by 1/3 (suicide, mental health).
- **3.5** Substance abuse + alcohol.
- **3.6** Halve road traffic deaths.
- **3.7** Universal SRH access.
- **3.8** Universal Health Coverage.
- **3.9** Reduce deaths from pollution + chemicals.
- **3.a** Tobacco FCTC implementation.
- **3.b** R&D + access to essential medicines.
- **3.c** Health workforce.
- **3.d** Health emergency preparedness.

**Lancet Commissions** continue to set the agenda — on Investing in Health (Jamison 2013), Adolescent Health (Patton 2016), Mental Health (Patel 2018), Planetary Health (Whitmee 2015), Pollution (Landrigan 2018), Climate Change + Health (Watts ongoing; Romanello).

**WHO 13th + 14th General Programme of Work** — **Triple Billion targets** (2019-2025 + extended):
1. **1 billion more people benefiting from Universal Health Coverage** (service coverage index + financial protection).
2. **1 billion more people better protected from health emergencies** (IHR core capacities + JEE scores).
3. **1 billion more people enjoying better health + well-being** (NCDs + risk factors + environment).

**Planetary health** — **Whitmee et al. 2015 'Safeguarding human health in the Anthropocene era' Lancet/Rockefeller Foundation Commission** + Sam Myers + Howard Frumkin + **Anthony Costello + Andrew Haines + Sam Frank** subsequent commissions. Health depends on stable Earth-system functions (climate, biodiversity, freshwater, nutrient cycles, oceans, land use, pollution); operationalizes Rockström planetary boundaries (Steffen 2015 Science) for health. **Planetary Health Alliance** (Harvard 2016+) coordinates research + curriculum + practice; **Brundtland Declaration on Planetary Health** São Paulo 2018.

**Lancet Countdown on Health and Climate Change** — annual indicators tracking exposures, impacts, adaptation, mitigation, finance (Watts; Romanello). 2024: record heat exposure, vector-borne expansion, $1.6T economic losses, slow adaptation. **The Lancet Countdown** is the canonical climate-health monitoring framework + frequently cited at COP climate negotiations.

**Health-climate synergies + co-benefits** — fossil-fuel transition + active transport + plant-based diet shifts + green building deliver large health gains alongside climate goals (Markandya 2018 Lancet PH; Smith 2014 ScienceDirect; Drew + Frank).

**One Health** — integrated human-animal-environmental health across surveillance + research + policy. Quadripartite (WHO + FAO + WOAH + UNEP 2022).

**Frontier topics**:
- **AI in public health** — outbreak detection (BlueDot), health-record analysis, drug + vaccine discovery (AlphaFold; mRNA platform; Insitro), syndromic + wastewater integration. Bias + privacy + equity considerations.
- **Personalized + precision public health** — genomic + behavioral data → targeted intervention (Khoury CDC). Tension with population approach.
- **Behavioral economics at scale** — UK BIT + 50+ peer units globally.
- **Antimicrobial resistance (AMR)** — O'Neill Review 2016 projected 10M deaths/yr by 2050 absent action; current attributable ~1.3M (GBD 2022 Lancet Murray).
- **Aging + frailty + dementia** — leading driver of HIC DALY burden; ADL + multimorbidity.
- **Mental health** — depression + anxiety leading cause of YLD globally (Lancet 2018 Commission Patel); huge treatment gap (~75% in LMIC).
- **Maternal + child health + adolescent transitions** — 5.0M under-5 deaths/yr (2024 IGME); 295k maternal deaths.
- **Health misinformation + infodemics** — WHO Infodemic Management Framework; Vaccine Confidence Project Larson.
- **Conflict + humanitarian crises** — Sphere standards; MSF + WHO + UNHCR; protracted emergencies (Syria, Yemen, Gaza, Sudan, DRC).

The modern frontier is **integration** — across digital + biological + behavioral + structural + ecological scales; across UHC + pandemic-preparedness + climate-adaptation + NCDs + AMR + mental health — within a single coherent system that protects + advances population health in the Anthropocene.

question.question: Design an integrated wastewater + clinical surveillance system for respiratory pathogens
question.goal: A mid-sized country wants to detect respiratory-pathogen outbreaks (SARS-CoV-2, influenza, RSV, novel) at the earliest possible signal. Design an integrated surveillance system + reason through tradeoffs.

steps.prompt: Which population segments does wastewater coverage reach? What's the population-denominator challenge?

acceptedAnswers: covers sewered + urban populations; denominator estimated from utility records + diurnal flow

hints: Who is on the sewer network?
steps.reveal: Wastewater covers populations connected to sewer networks — typically high in urban areas of HICs + MICs, low in rural areas + LMIC informal settlements (~40% global). Denominator estimated from utility records (households served) + diurnal flow + ammonia/creatinine/PMMoV normalization. The Biobot + CDC NWSS + EU Sentinel network use these methods. Lead time over clinical reporting ~4-7 days for SARS-CoV-2.

steps.prompt: What clinical + lab streams complement wastewater?

acceptedAnswers: syndromic ED + EHR + sentinel ILI + lab confirmation + genomic

steps.reveal: Complementary streams: (a) sentinel ILI / SARI network (WHO Global Influenza Surveillance + Response System, GISRS — 150+ National Influenza Centres); (b) emergency-department syndromic via ESSENCE-like chief-complaint analysis; (c) EHR-derived 'flu-like + respiratory' cohorts (Veterans Health, Epic, Cerner); (d) PCR + antigen positivity from clinical labs; (e) genomic sequencing via Nextstrain / GISAID for variant tracking; (f) telephone hotlines + symptom-tracking apps (UK ZOE, US Outbreaks Near Me). Each has lead time + bias profile.

steps.prompt: How would ML / AI assist signal detection across these streams?

acceptedAnswers: anomaly detection + ensemble nowcast + multi-stream fusion + retrospective evaluation

steps.reveal: (a) Anomaly detection — statistical control charts, change-point detection (Bayesian online), spatial scan (Kulldorff); (b) Nowcasting / forecasting — ensemble of mechanistic SEIR + autoregressive + Bayesian hierarchical (COVID-19 Forecast Hub Reich + Ray; Hub); (c) Multi-stream fusion — Bayesian sensor fusion combining wastewater + ED + lab + mobility; (d) NLP on news + ProMED + social media (BlueDot + HealthMap); (e) Genomic anomaly detection for variant emergence (Nextstrain phylogenetic; PANGO lineage). Important: false-positive control + retrospective evaluation are critical; Google Flu Trends overshot due to seasonal-pattern overfitting + media-influence drift.

(a) Privacy-by-design — wastewater aggregates anonymous community signal; mobility aggregated + differentially private (Apple + Google approach 2020-22); genomic sequences anonymized via GISAID; (b) Public oversight — community engagement, transparency, opt-in for individual symptom apps; (c) Data sharing — FAIR principles + interoperability (FHIR for EHR, GA4GH for genomic); (d) Cybersecurity + data-sovereignty (LMICs concerned about platform dependence on HIC-based providers); (e) Equity — ensure surveillance reaches underserved + minoritized groups; avoid amplifying biases.

steps.prompt: Connect to pandemic preparedness + 100 Days Mission.

acceptedAnswers: early detection enables 100-day vaccine R&D + countermeasure deployment

hints: Days saved at the front end.
steps.reveal: CEPI's 100 Days Mission (2021 UK G7) — develop + license + manufacture a vaccine within 100 days of pathogen identification. Wastewater + multi-stream surveillance can detect a novel pathogen weeks before clinical reporting alone; each day saved compounds via exponential growth → millions of cases + deaths averted. Jha + Ahmed + Inglesby have argued for an 'always-on' integrated surveillance system, not stood up only during a declared emergency. The Pandemic Fund + WHO Pandemic Hub + CDC CFA (Rivers + George 2022) are early architecture; full integration with WHO + IHR + One Health remains to be built.

question.question: Why does the 'planetary health' framework (Whitmee + Rockefeller 2015; Frank et al.) reframe public health for the 21st century?
options: Planetary health (Whitmee 2015 Lancet/Rockefeller Foundation Commission; Frank + Costello + Haines; Myers Planetary Health Alliance 2016+) recognizes that human health depends on the stability of Earth-system functions (climate, biodiversity, freshwater, nutrient cycles, oceans, land use, pollution). It operationalizes Rockström's planetary boundaries (Steffen 2015 Science) for health + frames PH as inseparable from environmental + ecological + One Health agendas. It integrates UN SDG 3 with SDGs 6, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15; integrates Lancet Countdown on Climate + Health with NCD + UHC + pandemic preparedness; calls for transdisciplinary action across health + agriculture + finance + urban planning + trade. The frame elevates equity + intergenerational ethics + post-growth economic thinking.
question.explanation:
**Planetary health** (Whitmee et al. 2015 Lancet 'Safeguarding human health in the Anthropocene era' Lancet/Rockefeller Foundation Commission; Sam Myers + Howard Frumkin + Howard Frank Lancet planetary-health series) integrates human-health science with Earth-system science. Builds on:
- **Planetary boundaries** (Rockström 2009; Steffen 2015 Science) — nine processes (climate, biodiversity, biogeochemical flows, etc.) within which humanity can operate safely.
- **Anthropocene** framing (Crutzen + Stoermer 2000) — human-dominated geological epoch.
- **One Health** — human + animal + environmental health interconnected.

Operationally: integrates SDG 3 (health) with SDGs 6 (water), 11 (cities), 12 (production), 13 (climate), 14 (oceans), 15 (life on land). Lancet Countdown on Health + Climate Change (Romanello + Watts) tracks 47+ indicators annually. **Planetary Health Alliance** (Harvard 2016+) coordinates curriculum + research. **São Paulo Declaration on Planetary Health 2021**. Reframes public health from individual + clinical / population-only to integrated socio-ecological + intergenerational equity-centered approach.

hints: Integrates with SDGs + One Health + climate.
slides.workedSolution: Planetary health (Whitmee + Rockefeller 2015; Frank + Myers + Frumkin) frames human health as dependent on Earth-system stability (planetary boundaries; Rockström + Steffen). Integrates SDG 3 with SDGs 6/11/12/13/14/15; Lancet Countdown + One Health + Planetary Health Alliance + São Paulo Declaration 2021.

question.question: Building national pandemic-preparedness architecture
question.prompt: Your country has 70 million people + scored 3/5 on its most recent JEE for IHR core capacities. The IHR amendments 2024 + Pandemic Accord 2025 will require new commitments. Design a 5-year pandemic-preparedness investment plan with $500M total. Discuss: (a) priority capacities (surveillance — wastewater + genomic; lab; emergency response; PoE; risk communication; workforce); (b) integration with routine PH (avoiding 'stand-up-during-crisis' fragility per Jha); (c) regional coordination (Africa CDC, ASEAN, PAHO model); (d) countermeasure manufacturing (mRNA hub Afrigen + regional vaccine alliance PAVM; CEPI partnership; 100 Days Mission alignment); (e) financing (domestic taxation + Pandemic Fund + Gavi + Global Fund + bilateral); (f) governance (national IHR focal point + intersectoral committee with finance + agriculture + animal health + environment); (g) equity (last-mile in low-coverage areas, marginalized groups); (h) climate-adaptation integration (heat + vector-borne expansion + WASH); (i) one-health coordination (FAO-WOAH-WHO-UNEP Quadripartite); (j) monitoring + evaluation.

question.question: If wastewater SARS-CoV-2 RNA gives a 5-day lead time over clinical case reporting, + a novel respiratory pathogen with doubling time 3 days emerges, how many cases (in factor of growth) are averted by responding 5 days earlier?
question.hint: Growth factor = 2^(5/3) ≈ 3.17. Responding 5 days earlier ≈ 3× fewer cases at the time of response.

question.prompt: In ≤120 words, explain how the planetary-health framework (Whitmee + Frank), the SDG 3 + Triple Billion agenda, and the modern surveillance + pandemic-preparedness architecture (IHR + Pandemic Accord + CEPI + 100 Days Mission) integrate into a single 21st-century public-health agenda.
question.rubric: Mentions: planetary health (Whitmee 2015 Lancet/Rockefeller; Frank + Myers + Frumkin; Planetary Health Alliance) frames human health as dependent on stable Earth-system functions (climate, biodiversity, planetary boundaries; Rockström + Steffen 2015); SDG 3 + Triple Billion (UHC + emergencies + well-being) is the operational policy + monitoring framework; pandemic-preparedness architecture (IHR 2005 + amendments 2024 + Pandemic Accord 2025; PEPFAR + Gavi + CEPI 100 Days Mission; CDC CFA + WHO Pandemic Hub; wastewater + syndromic + ML surveillance — Biobot + Jha + Brownstein) is the operational response system; Lancet Countdown tracks climate-health; One Health integrates animal + environment. Common thread: integration across digital + biological + ecological scales + intersectoral action + equity + intergenerational responsibility. Conclude: 21st-century PH = planetary-scope ambition + multistream surveillance + UHC + climate-adaptive + equity-driven.
